question:
Out of the following five figures, four are alike in some manner and one differs from these in that manner. Select the odd figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0473ba06fe007b6406603dfec327203e0e6f838bc3f2e4cd78f4a72785cf7096.png]
solution:
Logic : In each figure there Star, circle, parallel lines and hash elements are in this order in the clockwise direction.

So,

 
• Option - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9bd19fef481e8c97272d09460c7d372a622d7e9e888c5ada279887bf5d44808.png] ⇒ Here the order of elements is star, circle, parallel lines and hash in the clockwise direction.

 
• Option - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c2828febef5fa64b6c5feb5ac61336ad691fb4a6fdea4d5d8cac22729973128.png] ⇒ Here the order of elements is star, circle, parallel lines and hash in the clockwise direction.

 
• Option - (3) : 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af52e39ca8814331e7bb6eab5369f25c3aa52ffec547c848bdd9fe88300dc282.png] **⇒ Here the order of elements is star, parallel lines, circle and hash in the clockwise direction.**

 
• Option - (4) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d62a8a819464c0564b3b8f772e7d4213c94332b6479836e6be22afc2b9d2106f.png] ⇒ Here the order of elements is star, circle, parallel lines and hash in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e06ecca763cd11b779b48f64df5d8bd67ef887854dd4854620a4b50f05b9a0a8.png] 

Here, Figure - (3) is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option - (3)" is the correct answer.
